properties.name: Circuit Quest - Hutan Sensor
properties.description: Stage 1: collect four input sensors, explore the underground research cave, restore power, and assemble the Sensor Hub.

events.comment: LEVEL 1 / HUTAN SENSOR â€” native platformer terrain and objects; runtime, quests and assembly below.

inlineCode: // Runs once per frame as a GDevelop JavaScript event. World objects remain editable.

#cq-hud{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 24px;gap:10px}#cq-ui .hudbox{background:#08232be8;border:1px solid #3b676a;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 17px;box-shadow:0 5px 25px #001b2244}#cq-energy{height:5px;background:#1b5362;margin-top:8px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}#cq-energy span{display:block;background:#60e7df;height:100%;width:100%}#cq-tip{position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#082832ed;border:1px solid #5c9891;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:9px;text-align:center;max-width:85%;white-space:pre-line}#cq-ui .sensor{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;background:#0b2432;border:1px solid #2b515d;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;margin:9px 0}#cq-ui select{pointer-events:auto;background:#123746;color:#e4fbf3;border:1px solid #4e8b8d;padding:8px;border-radius:5px;max-width:100%}#cq-ui .sockets{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}#cq-ui .slot{border:1px dashed #6cb3a9;border-radius:7px;padding:10px;color:#a8d2ca;min-width:130px}#cq-ui .chip{cursor:grab;background:#235262;border:1px solid #6ad9c6;padding:8px;border-radius:5px;display:inline-block}#cq-ui .pass{color:#83ffc0}#cq-ui .fail{color:#ff9b8c}#cq-touch{display:none;position:absolute;bottom:80px;left:14px;right:14px;justify-content:space-between}#cq-touch button{opacity:.7;min-width:50px;touch-action:none}@media(pointer:coarse){#cq-touch{display:flex}#cq-tip{bottom:12px;font-size:12px}#cq-hud{padding:9px;font-size:12px}#cq-ui .card{padding:20px}}

NOVA / STAGE 01
HUTAN SENSOR
`;

c.inventory = () => {c.open(`SENSOR KIT

Inventory

${['DHT22','LDR','Soil','PIR'].map(n=>`${c.inv[n]?'✓':'○'} ${n==='Soil'?'Soil Moisture':n}`).join('   /   ')}

Kabel jumper: ${Object.keys(c.inv).length*3} / 12
Baterai Mini langsung memulihkan 20 energi.

`);c.button('resume',c.close);};

c.pause = () => {if(!c.started)return;c.open('PAUSE

Istirahat sejenak.

Kumpulkan empat sensor, pulihkan daya, lalu temui meja rakit di ujung hutan.

');c.button('resume',c.close);c.button('inventory',c.inventory);c.button('restart',()=>gdjs.evtTools.runtimeScene.replaceScene(s,'MainGame Scene',false));};

c.damage=()=>{if(c.invuln>0)return;c.hp--;c.invuln=1.5;c.say('Volt: Hati-hati! Tunggu celah aman atau gunakan Pulse Wave.');if(c.hp<=0){c.open('VOLT / COBA LAGI

Setiap percobaan memberi pelajaran.

HP Nova habis. Lompat melewati duri dan tunggu korsleting padam.

');c.button('retry',()=>gdjs.evtTools.runtimeScene.replaceScene(s,'MainGame Scene',false));}};

c.collect=n=>{if(c.inv[n])return;c.inv[n]=true;s.getObjects(n).forEach(o=>o.hide());c.say('Sensor ditemukan: '+({DHT22:'DHT22 — suhu & kelembapan udara',LDR:'LDR — intensitas cahaya',Soil:'Soil Moisture — kelembapan tanah',PIR:'PIR — gerakan'}[n]));};

c.quiz=()=>{if(c.inv.PIR){c.say('Rani: Terima kasih! PIR mendeteksi gerakan, bukan cahaya.');return;}c.open('RANI / PENJAGA KEBUN

Alarm kebun tidak bekerja.

Sensor mana yang mendeteksi gerakan orang di sekitar kebun?

');c.button('q1',()=>c.$('#feedback').textContent='LDR mengukur cahaya. Coba lagi.');c.button('q3',()=>c.$('#feedback').textContent='DHT22 mengukur suhu dan kelembapan udara. Coba lagi.');c.button('q2',()=>{c.collect('PIR');c.close();});c.button('back',c.close);};

c.open(`WORKBENCH / SENSOR HUB

Rakit mata dan telinga desa.

Tarik setiap sensor ke slotnya. Untuk tiap sensor, sambungkan VCC → 3V3, GND → GND, dan sinyal ke pin input.

${names.map(n=>`${n}`).join('')}
${names.map((n,i)=>`
Letakkan ${n}
${['VCC','GND','DATA'].map(k=>``).join('')}${n}.DATA → ${pins[i]}
`).join('')}

Touch: ketuk sensor, lalu ketuk slot. Papan input simulasi pembelajaran; pin analog A0/A1.

`);

if(errors.length){c.$('#assembly-feedback').innerHTML='

Percikan korsleting! Periksa: '+errors.join(', ')+'. Volt: cocokkan sumber daya, ground, dan sinyal.

';return;}

c.open('STAGE 01 / SELESAI

Sensor Hub
aktif.

Suhu 26.4°C · RH 68% · Tanah 54% · Cahaya 720 lx · Gerak terdeteksi

Keempat sensor sudah mengirim data. Desa Sensorika selangkah lebih dekat menuju Smart Greenhouse.

Hasil rakitan Sensor Hub dan StageUnlocked = 2 disimpan sebagai Global Variables. Stage 2 belum dibangun dalam proyek ini.

');c.button('explore',c.close);c.button('restart',()=>gdjs.evtTools.runtimeScene.replaceScene(s,'MainGame Scene',false));

c.open('CIRCUIT QUEST / STAGE 01

Hutan
Sensor.

Blackout melanda Desa Sensorika. Bantu Nova dan Volt menemukan empat sensor, menjelajahi gua penelitian, dan menghidupkan kembali Sensor Hub.

A D / ← → bergerak Space lompat W S tangga

E interaksi   J Pulse Wave   I inventory   Esc pause

01 Pos Ohm → 02 Jembatan → 03 Gua Sensor → 04 Meja Rakit

');
c.button('begin',()=>{c.started=true;c.close();c.say('Volt: Temui Prof. Ohm di terminal bercahaya. Tekan E untuk berinteraksi.',7);});

for(const pulse of s.getObjects('Pulse')){pulse.setX(pulse.getX()+pulse._dir*680*dt);pulse._life-=dt;if(pulse._life<=0)pulse.deleteFromScene(s);for(const n of ['Bug','Glitch'])for(const o of s.getObjects(n)){if(o.isVisible()&&hit(pulse,o)){if(n==='Bug'){const bat=s.createObject('Battery');bat.setPosition(o.getX(),o.getY());bat.setSize(36,36);}o.deleteFromScene(s);pulse.deleteFromScene(s);}}}

for(const o of s.getObjects('Bug')){const v=o.getVariables(),home=v.get('home').getAsNumber();let dir=v.get('dir').getAsNumber()||1;const dx=p.getX()-o.getX();if(Math.abs(dx)<200&&Math.abs(p.getY()-o.getY())<120)dir=Math.sign(dx)||1;else if(o.getX()>home+90)dir=-1;else if(o.getX()<home-90)dir=1;v.get('dir').setNumber(dir);o.setX(o.getX()+dir*65*dt);o.flipX(dir<0);if(hit(p,o))c.damage();}

for(const o of s.getObjects('Chest')){const n=o.getVariables().get('sensor').getAsString();if(near(o)&&!c.inv[n]){prompt='E · Buka peti '+(n==='Soil'?'Soil Moisture':n);if(pressed('e')){c.collect(n);o.setAnimation(1);}}}

if(near(s.getObjects('Terminal')[0])){prompt='E · Prof. Ohm / Research Station';if(pressed('e')){c.energy=100;c.hp=Math.min(5,c.hp+1);c.open('PROF. OHM / RESEARCH STATION

Sensor adalah input.

DHT22 membaca suhu dan kelembapan udara. LDR membaca cahaya. Soil Moisture membaca kelembapan tanah. PIR mendeteksi gerakan.

Peti DHT22 ada di hutan. LDR ada di platform tinggi setelah jembatan. Turun tangga ke gua untuk Soil Moisture dan temui Rani untuk PIR. Aktifkan pos daya sebelum memakai Workbench.

Rakit: VCC ke 3V3, GND ke GND. Sinyal: DHT22 → D4, LDR → A0, Soil → A1, PIR → D5.

Stasiun memulihkan energi dan 1 HP.

');c.button('continue',c.close);}}

if(near(s.getObjects('SensorPost')[0])){prompt='E · '+(c.power?'Daya pulih / isi energi':'Pulihkan gangguan listrik');if(pressed('e')){c.power=true;c.energy=100;c.say('Daya stabil! Korsleting padam. Meja rakit siap digunakan.');}}

if(near(s.getObjects('Workbench')[0])){prompt='E · Workbench / Sensor Hub';if(pressed('e')){if(Object.keys(c.inv).length<4)c.say('Volt: Kita masih membutuhkan '+['DHT22','LDR','Soil','PIR'].filter(n=>!c.inv[n]).join(', ')+'.');else if(!c.power)c.say('Volt: Aktifkan pos daya di sebelah kiri untuk menstabilkan listrik.');else c.assembly();}}
c.$('#cq-tip').textContent=c.t<c.until?c.message:prompt||'A / D · Bergerak     Space · Lompat     E · Interaksi     J · Pulse';
